title: Not very fluffy
text: Not very fluffy. This is a lot thinner than I thought it would be. I have other Vera Bradeley towels that I just love because they are so thick and absorbant and this is just a lot thinner than I thought. I don't really like the feel of it. It is pretty and the design is nice, and it works okay. It would be your preference of the fabric, but for me it wasn't great, especially considering the price point is high. It was just okay.
